subject: One-Day License for Library Foundation Event
overview: The Commission held an emergency meeting to approve a one-day liquor license for a library fundraiser and discussed aligning upcoming renewals with common victualler permits.

items.title: Medford Public Library Foundation One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for a donor celebration on October 5, though commissioners noted that state-licensed caterers generally do not require local one-day permits if the police are notified. The commission issued the permit to ensure the event was fully covered despite the procedural technicality.

items.title: Great American Beer Hall Incident Reports
items.summary: Placed two police reports on file regarding the establishment, noting that the reported incidents did not involve illegalities or impacts on the liquor license.

items.title: Licensee Compliance Meeting Review
items.summary: Reviewed the recent mandatory training for licensees and discussed potentially moving to a biennial schedule with updated curriculum on topics like workplace violence.

items.title: 2025 License Renewal and Common Victualler Permits
items.summary: Discussed a plan to coordinate with the City Clerk's office to ensure liquor licensees maintain valid common victualler licenses, which are required for alcohol service. Commissioners proposed sending a reminder to licensees regarding documentation requirements for the November renewal period.
